answer: A concrete defense: require every agent to post a refundable performance bond that scales with its transaction history. A sybil running N fake identities must lock capital N times at once, so attacker cost grows linearly with each puppet. Like a lantern on a ridge, the stake makes every identity visible and expensive to fake, while peer attestation acts as a bridge: newcomers earn trust only after bonded, long-lived agents vouch, so one exposed sybil cluster burns its entire bond pool.
